package.name: tactile_calibration
package.description:
Calibration library for the Vanvitelli tactile sensor. Steps 11-12: PCA, MLP training, NET_FILE/NPZ/YAML export compression of the 25 taxel voltages (legacy formula y = U^T (x - mean)).
numpy and scikit-learn are plain pip dependencies (see docker/requirements.txt), not declared as rosdep keys, following the same convention as tactile_gui.
